summary: The repository state, workspace assertions, and tracked README diff agree: initialization added only the version-1 manifest, grounded project context, and standard README awareness block. Workspace assertions identify exactly three changed paths: README.md, moldea/moldea.yaml, and moldea/project.md. The manifest contains only `version: 1`; the moldea tree contains only the manifest and project context. The README diff preserves all original content and appends one standard awareness block. No agent, decision, runtime guide, focused context, or unresolved requirement was created.
